notes:
- Logs are now uploaded to fareverly.com instead of fareverlogs.fr.
- You will need to sign in with Steam for an API key to securely upload your fight logs.
- Added a setting to prune old logs to reduce space consumption. Enabled by default, 1 year old logs are deleted.
- Added new event filter in Detailed Reports to filter by target.
- Reduced delay between the full team being ready and the countdown starting in Ready Check.
- Logs for Rift Gates now includes the number of gates closed.
- DPS Meter window now has a more obvious indicator that it's unlocked.
- Added new setting to adjust the scale of the UI components in the DPS Meter.
- DPS vs. Healing meter toggle now applies universally to all windows
